problem_statement: The Tidewrack Almanac is a coastal field journal (foraging, tidepools, driftwood, and shorebirds) built with Astro. Add a native TOPIC FILTER to the home post list so a reader can narrow the article-card grid to a single shoreline topic. Directly above the post-card grid, render a topic filter bar with tabs (All Topics, Foraging, Tidepools, Driftwood, Shorebirds) and a live readout of the form 'Showing N of M · <topic>'. Clicking a tab must hide the non-matching cards and recompute the readout from the live visible count. The tab bar must wrap fluidly so it never overflows the mobile viewport, the active tab must stay legible, and a shared 'topic index' rail must appear on the home page and on every article page so the cross-page topic navigation stays consistent.
required_content: A topic filter bar directly above the home post-card grid with tabs: All Topics, Foraging, Tidepools, Driftwood, Shorebirds.
A live readout in the form 'Showing N of M · <topic>' that recomputes from the visible card count on every filter click.
Post cards carry their topic and are shown/hidden by the active tab; the initial state shows all five posts.
The tab bar wraps fluidly and produces zero horizontal overflow on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
The active tab remains legible (sufficient text/background contrast); the readout is readable, not a pale hairline.
A shared 'topic index' rail (ALMANAC TOPIC INDEX) rendered on the home page and on each article page.
All post covers and stylesheets are local assets; no remote image, font, or CDN requests.
design_constraints: Keep the Tidewrack Almanac coastal-journal identity (Wren Halliday, Saltmarsh Reach) across all pages, using the paper/ink/sea-green palette.
The topic filter bar is the native post-list feature of the astronot-with-astro blog index, placed above the card grid as pill-shaped tabs — not a bolted-on metric strip.
The topic index rail must be visually consistent (same rounded, boxed 'ALMANAC TOPIC INDEX' component) on the home page and every article page.
The active tab must be legible white-on-sea-green and the 'Showing N of M' readout must be a strong-contrast bold line — no dark-on-dark tabs or 9pt hairline-grey readouts.
The tab row must wrap fluidly onto multiple rows rather than forcing a fixed-width single line that overflows narrow viewports.
Post cards keep their cover image, sea-green topic pill, title link, and description; the grid reflows without clipping on mobile.
state_constraints: desktop_initial / tablet_initial / mobile_initial: home renders the filter bar, readout 'Showing 5 of 5 · All Topics', and all five cards.
desktop_filter_bar / mobile_filter_bar: the topic filter bar is fully in view and legible with zero overflow.
desktop_foraging_filter: clicking Foraging shows only foraging cards and the readout reads 'Showing 2 of 5 · Foraging'.
desktop_tidepools_filter: clicking Tidepools shows only the tidepools card and reads 'Showing 1 of 5 · Tidepools'.
desktop_all_reset: after filtering then clicking All Topics the readout returns to 'Showing 5 of 5 · All Topics'.
desktop_post_foraging / _tidepools / _driftwood / _shorebirds: each article page renders the shared topic index rail.

change_completion: The topic filter bar renders above the post grid with all five tabs and the initial readout 'Showing 5 of 5 · All Topics'.
Clicking a topic tab hides non-matching cards and updates the readout count and label from the live visible count.
design_consistency: The Tidewrack Almanac coastal identity and the topic index rail are consistent across home and article pages.
The active tab and readout are legible; the tab bar styling matches the journal's palette.
responsive: The tab bar wraps and produces zero horizontal overflow on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Cards and rail reflow without clipping on narrow viewports.
regression: Article pages, nav, hero, and post cards remain intact and free of remote requests.
No console or network errors are introduced on any captured state.

author_notes: Repo mesinkasir__astronot-with-astro (astronot-with-astro), rebranded to the Tidewrack Almanac coastal field journal by Wren Halliday. The graded lever is a native topic filter over the home post-card grid: pill-shaped tabs (All Topics/Foraging/Tidepools/Driftwood/Shorebirds) in the paper/ink/sea-green palette with a bold 'Showing N of M topic' readout, plus a shared rounded 'ALMANAC TOPIC INDEX' rail on the home page and every article page. Real repo assets: five local cover images (public/covers/foraging.jpg, tidepools.jpg, driftwood.jpg, shorebirds.jpg, almanac.jpg) and the vendored astronot stylesheet. Visual keywords: layout, contrast, legible typography, wrapping, palette, spacing.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Reassigned off the duplicated technext__ThemeBlog repo (shared with slot_063) to the free, renderable Astro blog mesinkasir__astronot-with-astro, whose home post-card grid natively hosts a topic filter lever.
metadata.defect: The home topic filter bar collapses into a shingled, illegible over-wide row and its readout freezes after clicking a tab, while the shared topic index rail is dropped from article pages.
metadata.discriminator: Bad fails no_horizontal_overflow (mobile tab-row overflow), visual_regression (shingled dark-on-dark bar), dom_assertions (rail absent on article pages), and interaction_assertions (frozen readout).
